Saturday Night Live UK Mocks Prince Harry and Meghan's Return

The British version of the sketch comedy show Saturday Night Live has returned with a skit satirizing the recent return of Prince Harry and Meghan to the United Kingdom. The show featured a segment that parodied their presence in the UK. Reviews of the show's return noted its humor and compared it favorably to the US original.
